newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTAKIRJA BUYS ESTONIAN KIOSK COMPANY.
newsitem.headline: RAUTAKIRJA BUYS ESTONIAN KIOSK COMPANY.

text.p: Finnish retailing group Rautakirja Oy said in a statement on Friday its Estonian subsidiary Lehti-Maja Eesti AS had bought Estonian Parnu Ajakirjanduslevi AS, which operates 22 kiosks.
Total 1996 net sales of the kiosks, all in the Parnu region, were about 10 million Estonian kroons, Rautakirja said.
Lehti-Maja Eesti operates 10 kiosks in the Tallinn area and is also active in newspaper distribution. Its 1996 net sales were about 21 million Estonian kroons.
"The acquisition will strengthen Lehti-Maja Eesti's market positions in kiosk retailing and its expansion to become a nationwide chain in Estonia," Rautakirja said.
It did not give the price or any other financial details of the deal.
